title:
Comment of Raegan Hasselbring in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/3/2026

documents.name: 152247.txt
documents.text:
Raegan Hasselbring, Avon, CO.
Hello,

It is pertinent that you do not construct a data center near Cook Inlet. Hundreds of thousands of people use the resources here to care for their family. A data center will cause some degree of detriment to its natural surrounding and the species living in the adjacent area. 

I would like to announce my position against the construction of this data center for the wellbeing of the residents and biodiversity of Cook Inlet, Anchorage, and the Kenai Peninsula. 

Thank you,

Raegan Hasselbring
